version.value: Complete two-movement sonata for keyboard, performed on harpsichord
version.note: Hansen’s performing edition is unidentified. The section map includes the repeat of the first movement’s Moderato and Molto allegro, followed by Presto; times are broad passage guideposts.

performers.note: Commons explicitly identifies Hansen and the harpsichord. The instrument’s builder, model and pitch standard are not established from the selected file’s documentation.

date.note: The author/session field gives 22–23 October 1953. The individual take’s day is unspecified.

place.note: Commons gives Hannover and spells the venue ‘Beetovensaal’; the conventional spelling is used here.

sources.title: IMSLP — Keyboard Sonata in C major, K. 513
sources.locator: General Information: catalogue concordances, C major, keyboard, two movements: Pastorale, Moderato–Molto allegro; Presto.

sources.title: Scarlatti — Sonata K. 513, Pierre Gouin edition
sources.locator: Les Éditions Outremontaises, 2013; all four pages inspected visually. Moderato in twelve-eight; Molto allegro from bar 17; Presto in three-eight from bar 36; repeat signs and final cadence.

sources.title: Sonate K. 513 — manuscript witnesses
sources.locator: Manuscrits: Venice XII, no. 30, Ms. 9783 (1756), copied for Maria Bárbara; also Parma XIV, no. 30.
